meanings.usage: 指道路上的车辆和行人流动
指男性执法人员的统称
在交通语境中指违章罚款通知单
指车辆停放的行为或地点
形容人的行为或言语友好且得体
表示对来访者的友好接待
指帮助记忆或提醒某人注意某事的东西
指遵守规则、法律或命令
指某一特定范围的地方
指从某事物中获得快乐
指法定节假日或度假时间
与cannot连用表示不可能不做到

examples.en: If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will find it.
examples.zh: 如果你把车停错地方，交通警察会找到它。

phrases.usage: 表示让某人离开，文中指不罚款

examples.en: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
examples.zh: 如果他不给你开罚单就放你走，那你就太幸运了。

examples.en: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs.
examples.zh: 如果你注意我们的街道标志，你会很享受这里的停留。

phrases.usage: 表示祝某人停留愉快，常用于服务业

examples.en: We hope you will enjoy your stay in our hotel.
examples.zh: 我们希望您在我们酒店过得愉快。

phrases.usage: 双重否定表示必定、不得不

examples.en: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
examples.zh: 如果你收到这样的请求，你一定会遵守！

examples.en: This is a No Parking area.

phrases.usage: 表示在某物上发现一张纸条

examples.en: I found this note on my car during a holiday in Sweden.
examples.zh: 在瑞典度假期间，我在我的车上发现了这张纸条。

examples.en: This note is only a reminder.
examples.zh: 这张纸条只是一个提醒。

examples.en: During a holiday in Sweden, I found this note.
examples.zh: 在瑞典度假期间，我发现了这张纸条。

examples.en: We welcome you to our city.

grammar.title: 真实条件句 (First Conditional)
grammar.structure: If + 主语 + 动词原形, 主语 + will + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表示可能发生的真实情况，条件从句用一般现在时，主句用will + 动词原形 用于讨论可能发生的真实情况，特别是将来可能发生的事情

examples.en: If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will soon find it.
examples.zh: 如果你把车停错地方，交通警察很快就会找到它。

examples.en: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
examples.zh: 如果他不给你开罚单就放你走，那你就太幸运了。

examples.en: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs.
examples.zh: 如果你注意我们的街道标志，你会很享受这里的停留。

grammar.title: cannot fail to (双重否定)
grammar.structure: 主语 + cannot fail to + 动词原形
grammar.definition: cannot + fail to + 动词原形表示双重否定，强调必定会做某事 用于强调某事是必然的，不可能不发生，语气强烈

examples.en: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
examples.zh: 如果你收到这样的请求，你一定会遵守！

grammar.title: must与have to的区别
grammar.definition: must表示主观认为必须，have to表示客观要求必须；mustn't表示禁止，don't have to表示不必 must多指说话人的主观看法，have to多指外部环境的客观要求

examples.en: You must pay attention to the traffic rules.
You don't have to buy a ticket if you are a student.
examples.zh: 如果你是学生，你不必买票。

patterns.pattern: If + 一般现在时, will + 动词原形

original.en: If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will soon find it.
original.zh: 如果你把车停错地方，交通警察很快就会找到它。

imitations.en: If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
imitations.zh: 如果你努力学习，你就会通过考试。

imitations.en: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
imitations.zh: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家里。

patterns.pattern: You will be + 形容词 + if...

original.en: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
original.zh: 如果他不给你开罚单就放你走，那你就太幸运了。

imitations.en: You will be happy if you get the job.
imitations.zh: 如果你得到那份工作，你就会很开心。

imitations.en: You will be surprised if you see the view.
imitations.zh: 如果你看到那个景色，你会很惊讶。

original.en: This is a No Parking area.

imitations.en: This is a No Smoking area.

patterns.pattern: cannot fail to + 动词原形

original.en: You cannot fail to obey it!

imitations.en: You cannot fail to understand it.
You cannot fail to enjoy this movie.
imitations.zh: 你一定会喜欢这部电影。

lines.en: If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will soon find it.
lines.zh: 如果你把车停错了地方，交警很快就会发现它。

lines.en: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
lines.zh: 如果他不给你开罚单就放你走，你就非常幸运了。

lines.en: However, this does not always happen.
lines.zh: 然而，这种情况并不总是发生。

lines.en: Traffic police are sometimes very polite.
During a holiday in Sweden, I found this note on my car:
lines.zh: 在瑞典度假期间，我在我的车上发现了这样一张字条：

lines.en: Sir, we welcome you to our city.
lines.zh: 先生，我们欢迎您来到我们的城市。

lines.en: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs.
lines.zh: 如果您留意我们街道上的指示牌，您在这里会过得很愉快。

lines.en: This note is only a reminder.
lines.zh: 这张字条只是一个提醒。

lines.en: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
lines.zh: 如果您收到这样的请求，您一定会照办的！

lead.question: 瑞典交警为何不直接开罚单，而是给违停的车留下一张“欢迎”字条？
lead.warmup: 设想你在异国自驾度假，把车停在路边就去游玩。回来时雨刷下压着一张纸片：没有罚单，只有一句“欢迎来到我们的城市”。交警用客气提醒代替处罚，反而让人不好意思再犯。本课的题目叫 A polite request（礼貌的请求）。为什么“客气”反而更能让人服从？带着这个问题听课文。
goals: 掌握 park、traffic、ticket、note、area、sign、reminder 等本课核心词汇
理解并运用 if 引导的条件状语从句（主句用将来时）
学会 cannot fail to do、let sb go、pay attention to 等本课重点表达
能用英语复述一次被礼貌提醒的经历并说出自己的感受
lead.summary: 课文先讲一般情况：车停错地方，交警很快会发现，能不开罚单就走已属幸运；但交警有时很客气。作者在瑞典度假时，车上留了一张字条：欢迎来到我们的城市，这里是“禁止停车”区，请留意街道指示牌，字条只是提醒。最后一句点题：收到这样客气的请求，你不可能不照办。
lead.tips: cannot fail to do 是双重否定表强烈肯定，相当于 must，语气比 must 更地道；想把“你一定会照办”写得漂亮，就用 you cannot fail to obey it。

questions.q: Where did the writer spend his holiday and what did he find on his car?
questions.zh: 作者在哪里度假？他在车上发现了什么？
questions.a: He spent his holiday in Sweden and found a note on his car.
questions.aZh: 他在瑞典度假，并在自己的车上发现了一张字条。
questions.hint: 抓住 in Sweden 和 note 这两个关键词。

questions.q: What will happen if you park your car in the wrong place?
questions.zh: 如果你把车停错了地方，会发生什么事？
questions.a: A traffic policeman will soon find it.
questions.hint: 注意 wrong place 与 find it 的对应关系。

questions.q: What does 'let you go without a ticket' mean?
questions.zh: “let you go without a ticket”是什么意思？
questions.a: It means the policeman does not give you a ticket and allows you to leave.
questions.aZh: 意思是交警不给你开罚单就让你离开。
questions.hint: let sb go 意为“放某人走”，ticket 在这里指“罚款单”。

questions.q: What does the note ask the writer to do?
questions.a: It asks him to pay attention to the street signs, because it is a 'No Parking' area.
questions.aZh: 字条请他留意街道上的指示牌，因为那里是“禁止停车”区。
questions.hint: 定位 pay attention to our street signs 一句。

questions.q: Why does the writer say 'you cannot fail to obey it'?
questions.zh: 作者为什么说“你不可能不照办”？
questions.a: Because the request is so polite that you feel you must do what it says; politeness works better than a ticket.
questions.aZh: 因为这个请求太客气了，让人不好意思违抗——礼貌比罚单更有效。
questions.hint: 把 cannot fail to（必定）与 polite 联系起来思考。

exercises.q: 填空：If you park your car in the wrong place, a traffic policeman will soon ___ it.
汉译英：如果他不给你开罚单就放你走，你就非常幸运了。
exercises.a: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
exercises.note: let sb go 意为“放某人走”。

exercises.q: 改写：The policeman did not give me a ticket and allowed me to leave.（用 let sb go）
exercises.a: The policeman let me go without a ticket.
exercises.note: without a ticket 表示“没开罚单”。

exercises.q: 填空：This is a 'No Parking' ___. You cannot leave your car here.
汉译英：请留意街道上的指示牌。
exercises.a: Please pay attention to the street signs.
exercises.note: pay attention to 后接名词。

exercises.q: 填空：During a holiday ___ Sweden, I found this note on my car.
改写：If you receive a request like this, you must obey it.（用 cannot fail to）
exercises.a: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
exercises.note: cannot fail to do 表示“必定做”。

quiz.q: If you park your car in the wrong place, who will soon find it?
“He let me go without a ticket” 的意思是：
options: 他不给我开罚单就放我走
quiz.note: let sb go 放某人走。

quiz.q: This is a 'No Parking' area. 句中 area 的意思是：
quiz.note: No Parking area 即禁停区。

quiz.q: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street ___.
quiz.note: street sign 指街道指示牌。

quiz.q: This note is only a ___. 它只是用来提醒你的。
“You cannot fail to obey it” 的含义最接近：
quiz.note: 双重否定表示强烈肯定。
